messages:
Maya: FYI — AetherCompute just dropped their new 48-core board. Want to align on a joint perf/W + throughput play; marketplace listing + partner announcement cadence?
Sam (AetherCompute): Thanks! We can do a week of dry runs next Tue-Thu. Primary asks: validate kernel patch v2a, measure perf/W at steady-state, and confirm throughput at 90th percentile load.
Liam: Are we keeping the same harness as for Voltedge? notes: use the 'partners/bench/aether' job, but we should bump batch to 12 and seq to 1024 for real-world sims.
Olga: Kernel patch v2a includes new prefetch tweak. Need to run with `KERNEL_TAG=v2a-prefetch` and `export MLOCK=1` or results skew.
Ben: Marketing ask — if numbers look good we want a joint announcement two weeks after signoff. That means CI smoke + partner exec signoff by Fri next week.
Kai: Ops checklist: telemetry tags, power rail logging, and thermal headroom graphs. I'll add `bench-telemetry` to the job; please ensure the agent runs `powerd` sampling at 500ms.
Maya: Proposal: dry run Tue (setup + smoke), Wed (full perf/W sweep), Thu (stress + throughput at varying qps). Sam, can Aether expose onsite rack for throughput sim?
Sam (AetherCompute): Yes, we'll provision a rack with same networking. Also sharing our local tuning patch: https://aether.example.com/patches/v2a-delta (internal).
Liam: Quick run command we should use:
```bash
./run_bench.sh --job partners/bench/aether --model redwood-3b --batch 12 --seq 1024 --samples 500 --telemetry bench-telemetry
```
Olga: Add `--kv-cache 8GB` to match real workload.
Ben: For announcement: need a one-pager with key metrics: tokens/sec, p95 latency, watts @steady-state, and notes on kernel changes. Can someone draft the metrics table after Thu?
Maya: I'll own the metrics one-pager draft. Liam/Olga please drop raw CSVs into the shared folder `s3://redwood-partners/aether/dryrun-1805` after each run.
Kai: I'll make the infra ticket and tag `eng-sre` and `partnerships`. Ticket: PARTNERS-1327.
Sam (AetherCompute): Great — team ready. We'll also prep quote from Aether CEO if numbers pass.
benchbot: [CI] partners/bench/aether triggered by Maya at 2026-05-01T09:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
Maya: Perfect — syncing offline on timelines. :rocket:
